transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Launch publishes options.cwd. session.start and session.resume publish context.cwd when it is a non-empty string.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: session.context_changed publishes cwd when present and, when gitRoot is present, git.root, git.branch (string or null), git.headSha (string or null), and detached when a head exists and branch does not.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: options.title is passed as --name and is not an event. It is not field.project.name.
